harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-heal-skip-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-22: zoo owner, "do all of them in the order you think right" (the proposals of /next-experiments, issue #621).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#621). Four arms on one build, classes-18, 18 starts per
arm (72 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained. The skip bands are borg_caution.rs: the Borg does not heal when
randint0(100), reduced by the non-priest penalty and raised by the unique and lethal bonuses, is below the band's skip chance.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls reported start by start.
Report per arm and class: deaths and causes, CL at death, mean CL and depth; paired rescued and newly killed against ctl;
identical plays per arm (an arm whose keys equal ctl's did not exercise its setting); Cure potions quaffed per game and
left in the pack at death (recorder gear); the "# Healing Level" notes per game. Small and medium (classes-1800 starts
1-360) only on the owner's go. Directional (RULES 14).
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main f57499d0, does healing more often while wounded (no non-priest penalty; the skip chances of the heal bands halved; bands 2-5 never skipped) save the early deaths in which Cure potions stayed in the pack, or does it spend them sooner and add deaths?
